definitions.explanation: The point where two streets or edges meet.

examples.japanese: {角|かど}の{店|みせ}で{待|ま}っている。
examples.english: I'm waiting at the shop on the corner.

examples.japanese: {次|つぎ}の{角|かど}を{右|みぎ}に{曲|ま}がると、{駅|えき}が{見|み}えてくる。
examples.english: If you turn right at the next corner, you'll see the station.

examples.japanese: {机|つくえ}の{角|かど}で{頭|あたま}を{打|う}った。
examples.english: I hit my head on the corner of the desk.

examples.japanese: この{箱|はこ}は{角|かど}が{鋭|するど}いので、{小|ちい}さい{子|こ}どもがいる{家|いえ}では{気|き}をつけた{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: This box has sharp corners, so homes with small children should be careful.

notes:
{角|かど} means corner (of streets, buildings) or angle/edge.

KANJI READINGS (IMPORTANT):
- {角|かど}: corner of street/building, edge
- {角|すみ}: corner of a room (inside corner)
- {角|つの}: horn (animal)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {角|かど}を{曲|ま}がる: to turn the corner
- {角|かど}に{立|た}つ: to stand on the corner
- {次|つぎ}の{角|かど}: the next corner

IDIOMS:
- {角|かど}が{立|た}つ: to cause friction/offense
- {角|かど}を{取|と}る: to round off edges; to mellow (personality)

DIRECTIONS:
- その{角|かど}を{右|みぎ}に{曲|ま}がってください: Turn right at that corner
- {角|かど}の{店|みせ}: the shop on the corner
